items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Then I had old Bubber Miley on trumpet.

ctx.x: You see, it was my band. That's when (Nina May McKinney?), she was in the show. And (Plessey?), it was a spot where (Nina May McKinney?) was supposed to shoot this guy. And the gun wouldn't go off. So she walked over and hit him over the head with this pistol and blood started flying everywhere see? Because I'm the one that told him really to lead the band and the pit see? Because they had this other guy Haywood that wrote those bluer that Ethel Walters sang. What was his name? Donald Haywood, Donald Haywood.

And I didn't like the way he conducted at all, see? So I told Tom Whaley you going to conduct this band, see? With Schiffman and everything in there, he wanted Donald Haywood to direct the band and everything. Then I had old Bubber Miley on trumpet.
Oh, you had some good people in your band?
